question: The selling price of 50 books is equal to the cost price of 16 books. Find the loss or gain percentage.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the CP of 1 book be 1 unit.

⇒ Total CP of 50 books = 50 units

⇒ Total SP of 50 books = CP of 16 books = 16 units

⇒ Loss = Total CP − Total SP = 50 − 16 = 34 units

⇒ Loss % = (34 ÷ 50) × 100 = 68%

**∴ The correct answer is 68% loss.**
